title: rgOS
tagline: A touch library below, artwork above. Firmware built around both screens.
what: My own firmware for the Anbernic RG DS, a two-screen handheld, built on ROCKNIX. The menus are rebuilt around both screens: a touch library on the bottom, art and what's playing on the top.
built: Rebuilt the frontend around both screens, with EmulationStation running headless only to launch games
Wireless Transfer: a web page the handheld hosts so I can drop ROMs, saves and BIOS files in from a browser
Pal Park: one bank for every Pokemon across every save on the card, with rollback and legality checks
23 PC games tested on the device; for 9 of them you add your own copy of the game's files
progress: The source is public; this is my build.

remix.changed: Replaced the frontend with two Python and SDL2 screens, and added transfer, Pal Park, ports, DOS and offline achievements.

making.problem: On other firmware the second screen is an afterthought that fights the first one for focus.
how: EmulationStation stays, but headless: it still picks the core, maps the controller and handles save states, and draws nothing.
Two Python and SDL2 screens own the interface: touch-first browsing on the bottom, artwork and now-playing on top.
What's baked into the image is kept apart from what lives in storage, so I can iterate fast without reflashing.

proof.caption: Activity: the games I played, with the calendar and recency details kept private.

credits: Frontend, transfer portal, Pal Park, DOS and port launching: me
